notablePrerequisites:
Luxior attached to Nissa.
You control two creatures and two lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
description:
Activate two creatures and two lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, untapping those creatures and lands.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Nissa.
Activate Luxior's first equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Nissa.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat but activate Nissa's second loyalty ability instead in step 2, and you may activate Eldrazi Displacer any number of times.
